title: fix(app-shell): a hatch-elevated type's packaged item opens read-only in the editor and the matrix (objectui#12169)
body:
Fixes #12169

Clause-②: no

## The claim's first measurement: the item read already serves the per-item answer

**Served.** The per-item answer is `editable`, on the layered item read `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers`. The gates now read it. Citations are by file and symbol, not by line address (AGENTS.md #11). Trees read: objectstack `main` `018b077fb` (read-only) and objectui `main` `2498a07`.

- **Server, the route.** `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` registers `GET` on the path that ends `/:type/:name/layers`, and its handler calls `serveMetaItemLayered`. That method serves the protocol's `getMetaItemLayered` answer through `createMetaLayeredAnswer` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`). The doc of `createMetaLayeredAnswer` says "every other key of the answer (`overlayScope`, `_diagnostics`, the ADR-0010 protection envelope) rides through untouched".
- **Server, the verdict.** `getMetaItemLayered` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) returns `editable: lockState.editable`, taken from `servedLockState`. That method computes `editable` as `evaluateLockForWrite(itemLock.lock) === null && this.packagedBaseRefusal({ type, name, operation: 'save' }) === null`. `packagedBaseRefusal` asks `refusePackagedBaseOverride`, which refuses when `isSealedManagedItem(type, name)` holds, and that is `isArtifactBacked(type, name) && !registryAllowsOverlay(type)`. Only the registry's overlay opt-in is read: "⛔ The hatch is not consulted".
- **Server, its own pin.** The objectstack test `protocol.read-lock-flags-write-door.test.ts` has the case "[ADR-0131 D6] the operator hatch does not open the packaged base, and the read says so — the same predicate the door reads". It sets `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE='flow,action'` and asserts that the packaged item reads `{ lock: 'full', editable: false, deletable: false }`, with the save door and the delete door both refused. It landed in objectstack `e02833c24`.
- **Client.** `MetadataClient.layered()` (`packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`) parses the body with `GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema` and returns `editable: envelope.editable`. The type `MetadataLayered` already declares `editable?: boolean`, so no type changes.
- **Why provenance alone does not decide.** A packaged item is served `provenance: 'package'` on a hatch-elevated type and on a registry-opt-in type alike. Only `overrideSource` could tell the two apart, and reading it would copy the seal rule into the client. `editable` decides without it.
- **How the artifact arm knows "packaged" today.** The client derives it from the served layers: `code` is non-null, `code._packageId` is not `'sys_metadata'`, and `provenance` is not `'org'`. This is `isArtifactItem` in `ResourceEditPage` and `isArtifactBackedLayer` in `PermissionMatrixEditor`. Unchanged.

## What was actually wrong, measured on `main` `2498a07` before any edit

The fixture is a hatch-elevated `agent` entry and the envelope the server serves for a sealed packaged item (`lock: 'full'`, `editable: false`):

- **The editor's Save gate already held.** It showed no Edit, no Save and no design-mode tab, and it drew the lock banner. The probe reading was `{"editing":"true","designTab":false,"editButtons":0,"save":false,"lockBanner":true}`. The editor draws the Edit button the card reports only when the layered double serves `editable: true` for the packaged item, as the objectui#12141 pin's `packagedItem()` double does (the card's probe was not committed, so its fixture is not read here). The server no longer serves `editable: true` for a sealed item.
- **The designer auto-on effect** carried its own copy of the type half without the item half. So the canvas opened in design mode (`editing` true): it took edits, the page reported unsaved changes, and there was no Save.
- **The permission matrix's artifact tier** read the type flag alone. A packaged set of a hatch-elevated `permission` type offered live checkboxes and a Save that the server refuses (403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`).

## The change

- `ResourceEditPage.tsx`: `itemWritable` (the type tier and the served `editable`) is computed once, above the designer auto-on effect. The effect and the Save gate both read it (`canWrite = itemWritable && canAuthor`). The value of `canWrite` is unchanged. An item the server refuses for its own ADR-0010 lock also stops opening in design mode.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, the artifact tier only:
  - The load effect keeps the served `editable` (`servedEditable`) beside `codeIsArtifact`, from the same envelope.
  - The artifact arm is `allowEnvironmentOverlay && servedEditable !== false`.
  - `lockedByArtifactTier` names the artifact tier whenever that arm is closed and the type tier is open. The sealed set therefore gets the artifact caption and "Clone to customize", as a packaged set does when the hatch is off.
  - `undefined` (a server that sends no `editable`) keeps today's behaviour.
  - The `sys_capability` read on the objectui#7611 C9 list is not touched.
- No gate reads `overrideSource`.
- In passing (AGENTS.md #11): a `PermissionMatrixEditor` comment cited three sibling sites by cross-file line address, and all three were stale. They are now cited by symbol.
- No shared predicate module: the claimed file surface has no new module. Both pages read the same served field with the same tri-state convention, and the pin asserts that they agree on each fixture.

## The writability badge (`DirectoryPage`, `PageShell`): no code change

The badge describes a type, one entry per type, so no per-item answer reaches it. What "does not claim more than that" can mean there:

- The tooltip already says it, from objectui#12141 (`e531116`): "Writable via the OS_METADATA_WRITABLE env var: it opens the items no package ships, never an item a package ships". The new pin asserts that tooltip on the same fixtures.
- The label (`engine.badge.writable`) is the remaining type-level claim. A label for the env source, such as "writable (runtime items)", would be copy in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. That file belongs to objectui#12171 this round, so the change is reported here and not made.
- A per-item badge on an item page's header would need a new prop on `PageShell`. The package entry exports `PageShell` as `MetadataPageShell`, so that is a published type change and out of this card's bounds.

## Pins: `packagedItemWriteGate-12169.test.tsx`

Each case is one fixture, and every gate is asserted on it: the editor (with a stub preview, so the canvas's `editing` prop is visible), the matrix, and the header badge.

- **Hatch-elevated, packaged, served `editable: false`.**
  - Editor: not in design mode, no Edit, no Save, the lock banner.
  - Matrix: no Save, every grant disabled, the artifact caption and its clone.
  - Badge: the tooltip says the hatch never opens an item a package ships.
- **The same type, runtime-only, served `editable: true`.** The editor opens in design mode. The matrix offers Save with live grants.
- **CONTROL: registry opt-in (`overrideSource: 'registry'`), packaged, served `editable: true`.** The editor (`view`) opens in design mode. The matrix offers Save. The badge names the ADR-0005 opt-in. Same as before this change.
- **Crossed cases.**
  - `env` with a served `editable: true` is writable.
  - `registry` with a served `editable: false` is read-only.
  - So the gates follow the served answer and never `overrideSource`.

**Red, then green.** The pin file is byte-identical in both runs.

- Before (implementation not yet written, tree at `2498a07`): `Tests  3 failed | 8 passed (11)`.
  - "the editor opens it read-only…": `expected 'true' to be 'false'` on `editing`.
  - "the matrix artifact tier agrees…": a Save button where null was expected.
  - "`registry` with a served `editable: false`…": `editing` was `'true'`.
- After (`6b91355`): `Tests  11 passed (11)`.

## Verification at HEAD `92b0df6`

- Build of the dependency closure: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` gave `28 cached, 28 total` and exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose include holds the new test) exited 0.
- Targeted vitest exited 0 with `Test Files  77 passed (77)` and `Tests  479 passed (479)`. It covered:
  - every `ResourceEditPage.*`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.*` and `DirectoryPage.*` test, both `*environmentOverlay-12141*` pins, and the new pin;
  - the other app-shell tests that render either page: `ConditionWidget.conditionSubjects`, `SchemaForm.instanceIdScope`, `SchemaForm.topLevelUnion-11251`, `diagnostics-gate`, `FlowObjectListField.commit`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel`, `StudioDesignSurface.createAppOpensInterfaces-11794`, `StudioDesignSurface.pillarNavGuard` and the `console/__tests__/AppContent*` routes.
- Gates, all exit 0:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`
  - `pnpm check:changeset-claims`
  - `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`)
  - `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots` and `check-lint-coverage`
- Lint was narrowed to the three touched source and test files, under the root `eslint.config.js`, which declares no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` (not type-aware). So no untouched file's verdict can move.
  - `--format json` reported 3 files, 3 errors and 76 warnings.
  - The same command on the `2498a07` versions of the two source files gives the same 3 errors (the `react-hooks/static-components` sites, inline-disabled in the package's own `eslint .`) and the same 76 warnings in total.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Caller tier, the same symptom (reported for the seat, left as is here):** the designer auto-on effect still does not read `canAuthor`.
  - Measured by a probe on this branch, with `useCanAuthorMetadata` false and a writable item: `{"editing":"true","designTab":false,"save":false,"capabilityBanner":true}`. A caller without `manage_metadata` lands in design mode with nothing to save.
  - That is the objectui#7611 caller tier, not this card's item tier. It is left to the seat.
- **Item page header:** on a sealed item, the header badge still reads "writable" (with the scoping tooltip) above the lock banner. The reasons are in the badge section above.
- **Outside the artifact tier,** `PermissionMatrixEditor` reads no `editable`. A runtime-created set carrying an ADR-0010 `_lock` would still offer Save. No producer of such a set is known. Noted only.
- **Sequencing, already tracked on objectstack#22340:** objectstack `main` (`018b077fb`) still writes `allowOrgOverride` on `/meta/types`. The `allowEnvironmentOverlay` that objectui reads arrives with its S2 PR, still a draft. Until it lands, these gates see no overlay flag on any type. The served `editable` read added here does not depend on that.

## Rollback

Revert this PR. The gates go back to reading the type flag alone in the two places named above. Nothing is stored or published differently.
